key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns policy mirror descent for terminal-reward language generation into a trajectory-level objective that avoids intermediate value estimation while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a critic-free reinforcement learning recipe for LLM reasoning, potentially simplifying training pipelines and reducing the cost and instability of value-function learning.
method: Use Bellman equations to rewrite PMD for autoregressive generation with terminal rewards.
Optimize a trajectory-level objective instead of estimating state values at intermediate tokens.
Apply a practical loss with a mismatch-correction weight given by a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, where BPO demonstrates effectiveness.
watch_item: The practical gain depends on how well the approximated loss and smoothed mismatch-correction weight behave in large-scale LLM training.
